description: Sanitized print geometry extracted from the original HC Excel masters.

units.sourceBoxPt: Excel COM screen point dimensions relative to top-left of official bounds, before scale
units.pageBoxPt: Actual Excel printer geometry in A4 page points; already scaled and positioned
units.textBoxPt: Merged cell or permitted Excel-style overflow text area in page points
units.borderRectsPt: Exact Excel PDF cell border rectangles in page points; excludes text underline
units.fontPrintSizesPt: Actual font sizes found in native Excel PDF by source font size; do not scale a second time

sanitization.staticTextPolicy: Only official template wording; all transactions, signatories and participant data use bindings

rendering.numberFormatPolicy: Use cell source numberFormat; numeric money is shown with Indonesian separators and two decimal places like the source
rendering.blankParticipantPolicy: All bindings blank for inactive slots, including sequence, account code, amount and slash
rendering.underlinePolicy: Draw beneath actual rendered text using font underline style; source reference dynamic underline lengths are not copied
rendering.paginationPolicy: Do not add participants beyond template capacity or resize the official table
rendering.fitPolicy: Validate content fits its textBoxPt before finalization; merged text cannot overflow in Excel
rendering.fontPolicy: Use locally installed licensed Calibri and Arial; do not upload system font files to public hosting
rendering.justifiedStaticTextPolicy: If referenceStaticLines.words is present, draw each word at its native xPt and baselinePt. PDF justification can omit literal space glyphs; line.text has source spaces restored for fallback rendering.

bindingNotes.document.number: Full printed line including Nomor: prefix
bindingNotes.document.paymentReference: Full document.number line followed by comma and issue date
bindingNotes.document.paymentRepresentative: First participant name plus selected template representativeSuffix
bindingNotes.participants.i.sequence: Active 1-based sequence plus selected template participantSequenceSuffix; blank inactive
bindingNotes.participants.i.separator: Slash for active SPPD participant; blank inactive
bindingNotes.document.itineraryText: Source Excel merges C25:E25 on DP/LP; validate fit before finalizing
